scope: static review, bounded disposable local penetration tests and remediation; no production deployment

typescript.database: real Postgres with restricted app/worker roles

commands: REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 REQUIRE_NATS_TESTS=1 REQUIRE_BROWSER_TESTS=1 TEST_DATABASE_URL=<disposable-admin-url> go test -count=1 -json ./apps/api-go/... ./packages/go/eventbus/...
pnpm turbo run lint typecheck build
fixtureNotes: Unit tests use ephemeral audit signing keys. Reset only disposable audit fixtures before stable-key penetration probes; legacy untrusted production signatures are never re-signed.
This machine requires SWC_NATIVE_BINDING_CACHE to be a private temporary directory (mode 0700); default cache permissions were rejected by the native addon.
limits: Production ballot proof verification and threshold decryption require a real external cryptographic component; missing verification denies casting.
Production mesh/TLS/certificates and existing-volume credential migration remain operational prerequisites. Rendered manifests were tested; no live cluster was tested.
The three raw npm advisories are mitigated by pinned reproducible local patches, not upstream version fixes. One Go OpenPGP module notice concerns a package neither imported nor shipped.
No container-image advisory scan, physical passkey test, load/flood test or production probe was performed.
